title: Merge Sort
brief: Return a sorted copy of an integer array. Do not mutate the input. Preserve duplicate values. Use a shared auxiliary array, not a new array at every recursive call.
rubric: Half-open ranges and a terminating base case
Stable merge chooses left on equality
Θ(n log n) time and Θ(n) auxiliary storage

title: Disjoint Set Union
brief: Process unions on n initially isolated vertices and return the component count. Use path compression and union by size or rank. Duplicate unions must not reduce the count.
signature: static int solve(int n, int[][] edges)
rubric: find returns a representative
Only successful union decreases count
Near-constant amortized operations

title: Prim’s Algorithm
brief: Return the MST total weight for an undirected graph with vertices 0..n−1. Edge rows are [u,v,weight]. Return 0 for n=0. Throw IllegalArgumentException if disconnected. Accumulate weights in long.
signature: static long solve(int n, int[][] edges)
rubric: Heap contains crossing candidates
Skip stale entries for visited vertices
Count visited vertices to detect disconnection

title: Kosaraju’s Algorithm
brief: Return the number of strongly connected components in a directed graph, including isolated vertices. Edge rows are [from,to]. Use finish order and the transpose.
signature: static int solve(int n, int[][] edges)
rubric: First pass records vertices on exit
Second pass uses the transpose in decreasing finish order
O(V+E); recursion depth considered

title: Edit Distance
brief: Return the minimum number of unit-cost insertions, deletions, and substitutions converting a into b. Inputs are non-null Java strings. Empty strings are valid.
signature: static int solve(String a, String b)
rubric: State is a pair of prefix lengths
Initialize both empty-prefix boundaries
Transition takes min of delete, insert, substitute

title: KMP Preprocessing
brief: Return the prefix-function array. pi[i] is the longest proper prefix of s[0..i] that is also a suffix. Empty input returns an empty array.
rubric: Fallback uses pi[j−1], not j−1
Proper border cannot equal full prefix length
O(n) amortized character comparisons

title: Polynomial Rolling Hash
brief: Return the high-order polynomial hash of s with a=1,…,z=26, base 31, modulus 1,000,000,007. Inputs contain only lowercase ASCII letters, including empty. Use long multiplication.
rubric: h=(h*31+symbol)%MOD
Document the orientation of powers
Equal hashes do not prove equal strings

title: Kasai’s Algorithm
brief: Given a string and a valid suffix array permutation, return LCP with LCP[0]=0, LCP[r]=lcp(SA[r],SA[r−1]). Use inverse ranks and carry the match length.
signature: static int[] solve(String s, int[] sa)
rubric: Build inverse rank array
Reset carried length at rank 0
Decrease carried length by at most one each text step
